job_preferences.language_policy: Search and apply to both German- and English-language roles. German-language applications must be in German. German proficiency must always remain truthful as B1/actively learning. Do not automatically discard a German-language vacancy merely because it asks for stronger German; flag the language requirement and let overall fit determine priority.
job_preferences.career_strategy: Search broader than literal CV job titles. Treat underlying engineering capabilities as evidence for adjacent occupations, while clearly identifying missing requirements and never fabricating experience. Full-time professional roles are a primary target, not an exception.

truth_rule: Only use facts supported by this profile or configured source CVs. Never invent experience, skills, education, certificates, employers, dates, achievements, language level, work authorization, or responsibilities. Adjacent/stretch roles are discovery opportunities, not claims of qualification.
